capabilities: : Renders progress bars for notes and PDFs
: Displays reading statistics and progress percentage
: Tracks reading regions using time counting
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.5.0 or later. System scale above 100% may affect rendering precision.
problem: Users lack a visual way to track reading progress or remember their last position within notes and PDFs in the file explorer.
summary: Renders a reading progress bar below markdown and PDF notes in the file explorer, tracking reading time and position.
